name: abbasalikhan-com
description: Personal site for Abbas Ali Khan — abbasalikhan.com

scripts.build: astro check && npm run check:functions && astro build && npm run finalize
scripts.check:functions: tsc --noEmit --ignoreConfig --strict --allowImportingTsExtensions --target es2022 --lib es2022,dom --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --skipLibCheck functions/api/subscribe.ts
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run verify && wrangler pages deploy
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy --branch=preview
